items.description: Between 1 and 50 Feed Connections to create. No element may be null.

AccountType.description: The high-level type of the account. `BANK` covers every account type other than a credit card.

accountId.description:
The Xero Bank Account to connect the feed to. Required. An all-zeros GUID is treated as
though the field were absent.

accountToken.description:
The financial institute's identifier for the account. Must be unique within your
financial institute. Some financial institutes additionally constrain its format.

currency.description:
ISO-4217 currency code. Must match the currency of the Xero Bank Account named by
`accountId`, and must be a currency the Organisation holds.

country.description:
ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code. Required only when the Application supports multiple
regions. Talk to your Partner Manager to confirm whether this applies to you.

accountNumber.description: Ignored. Taken from the Xero Bank Account named by `accountId`.

accountName.description: Ignored. Taken from the Xero Bank Account named by `accountId`.
